name: NURS 310 weight table and 'Mon 9/14' calendar
text:
NURS 310: Adult Health Nursing I
School of Nursing — Fall 2026
Course faculty: Prof. Dana Whitfield, MSN, RN · Clinical coordinator: J. Ortiz, RN
Class: Mon 8:00-11:50 AM, Health Sciences 140 · Clinical: Thu/Fri (site assigned)

Course Outcomes
1. Apply the nursing process to adults with common acute and chronic conditions.
2. Demonstrate safe medication administration in the clinical setting.
3. Communicate effectively with patients, families, and the care team.

Evaluation Methods                          Weight
Unit Exam 1                                 15%
Unit Exam 2                                 15%
Unit Exam 3                                 15%
Comprehensive Final                         25%
Dosage calculation competency (pass/fail)   Required
Care plan 1                                 10%
Care plan 2                                 10%
ATI practice assessment                     5%
Case study presentation                     5%
Clinical performance                        Pass/Fail

A minimum weighted exam average of 77% is required to pass the course.

Calendar
Mon 8/24   Orientation; fluid & electrolytes
Mon 8/31   Acid-base balance — Dosage calculation competency (in class)
Mon 9/7    NO CLASS (Labor Day)
Mon 9/14   Perioperative care
Mon 9/21   UNIT EXAM 1
Fri 9/25   Care plan 1 due by 2359 (Canvas)
Mon 9/28   Respiratory disorders
Mon 10/5   Cardiovascular disorders I
Mon 10/12  Cardiovascular disorders II
Mon 10/19  UNIT EXAM 2
Mon 10/26  Endocrine disorders
Fri 10/30  Care plan 2 due by 2359 (Canvas)
Mon 11/2   Renal disorders
Mon 11/9   GI disorders; ATI practice assessment due 11/11
Mon 11/16  UNIT EXAM 3
Mon 11/23  Case study presentations
Mon 11/30  Musculoskeletal & integumentary
Mon 12/7   Comprehensive review
Mon 12/14  COMPREHENSIVE FINAL EXAM, 8:00 AM

Clinical absences must be made up and may result in course failure.
notes: The dosage competency is an in-class test (exam); ATI practice assessment is an online due item (task).
